Surat & Mumbai: Aukera raises Rs 90 crore. In debt, not equity this time.

સુરત અને મુંબઈ: ઓકેરાએ ₹90 કરોડ ઋણ ભંડોળ એકત્ર કર્યું, ઇક્વિટી નહીં.

The Bengaluru lab-grown jeweller took debt from Alteria Capital and others, months after its $15 million equity round. Stores grew 13 to 35 in a year, as Titan launches its own lab-grown line, beYon.

Full story on caratcapital.org, link in bio. Photos via Wikimedia Commons, credited per slide. Source: Diamond World, 17 Oct 2026.
